get.summary: Search bookable chargers near a point for a window
get.description: Online chargers accepting bookings, with an availability window covering the whole slot and no booking overlapping it, nearest first. Positions are approximate.
Listing, host summary, rating and free slots for the next 7 days. The address and exact position are included only for a driver with a confirmed, arrived or active booking at this charger.

post.description: Creates the host profile (once) and a Stripe Express account for payouts, and returns a fresh link to Stripe's onboarding.

country.description: Country of the host's payouts account

post.description: Checks the charger can connect (Zappi v2.1, serial starting with 2, or Zappi GLO) and returns the OCPP URL, ChargeboxID and password to enter in the charger's account. The password is shown once and stored only as an argon2 hash. Asking again for a charger still connecting replaces its password.

location.description: Exact position; shown to drivers only once booked

get.summary: Wait for a charger to connect
get.description: Long-polls until the charger sends its first BootNotification, or `wait` seconds pass (capped by the server), then returns its state. Poll again while `connected` is false.

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Seconds to wait for the charger to connect (capped by the server)

patch.summary: Set a charger's price, availability and listing
patch.description: Changes only the fields sent. `availability` replaces every window; price, kWh cap and instant book apply to every window. Publishing (`acceptingBookings: true`) needs the charger online on firmware 5.794 or later, payouts enabled and at least one window, otherwise 409 lists what is missing.

post.description: Books a charger for a slot inside one of its availability windows. With instant book the booking is confirmed at once; otherwise it waits for the host. The quote is the slot's minutes at the hourly price, with no fee added. A slot starting within 6 days is authorised on the card now (manual capture); a later one keeps the saved card and is authorised 24 hours before the start. An overlapping slot is 409 and nothing is charged; a declined card is 402.

from.description: Start of the slot, on a whole minute

to.description: End of the slot (exclusive), on a whole minute

vehiclePlate.description: Number plate of the car being charged; shown to the host

paymentMethodId.description: A saved card; the default card when omitted

get.description: Latest slot first; filter by status and by a window the slot overlaps.
For its driver or the host of its charger; anyone else gets 404. The driver sees the address and exact position only while the booking is confirmed, arrived or active.

post.description: The host of the charger confirms a requested booking; its idTag is issued. 409 if the slot has been taken since.
The host turns a request down; the card authorisation is released.

The driver or the host cancels a requested or confirmed booking. A driver cancelling a confirmed booking after the host's cutoff (default 2 hours before the start) pays one hour at the hourly price, capped at the quote; otherwise the authorisation is released. Once the driver has arrived a booking can only be stopped (409).
Creates the driver's Stripe customer on first use and a SetupIntent for an off-session card. The first card saved becomes the default.

get.description: Brand, last four digits and expiry only.

post.description: The card bookings use when they do not name one.
Verified against the Stripe-Signature header and processed once per event id; a redelivered event is acknowledged without repeating its effects.
